runtime_artifacts.work_capsule: work/<ticket>/CURRENT.json (schema work-capsule/v1, sealed with a compare-and-swap current_hash)
runtime_artifacts.writer_lease: leases/<lease-id>.json (schema lease/v1, one writer per overlapping path/ref)
runtime_artifacts.reconstruction_drill: opsctl drill (clean-clone / context-wipe reconstruction, provider-neutral); spec in RECONSTRUCTION-DRILL.md; goldens in generated/reconstruction/
runtime_artifacts.owner_command: opsctl command --dry-run (--request <json> | --file <path>): enumerated, authenticated, allowlisted, compare-and-swap-checked; dry-run only (no live mutation this stage)
runtime_artifacts.owner_hud: generated/hud/index.html (read-only, redacted, deterministic); a plain static file served by the repository's own branch-published GitHub Pages site (Deploy from a branch: main, root) and reachable at /hud/; no separate publish workflow. Publishing main means the live site is the released state: a regenerated HUD on dev reaches it only through an owner-authorized dev -> main promotion.
runtime_artifacts.migration: opsctl migrate [--plan]: read-only inventory + classification of legacy sources (governance/migration.json) with proposed genesis stubs; report in generated/migration/PLAN.md; no legacy evidence mutated

deferred_next_stages: owner-command live executor (append decision event + CAS-update state, protected environment)
migration cutover: create real genesis capsules + replace legacy entrypoints with one pointer (owner-gated)
independent review then exact dev -> main promotion decision
